explanation: Append the root, nonleaf left boundary, all leaves left to right, then the reversed nonleaf right boundary. Excluding leaves from each side boundary and traversing leaves below the root prevents duplicates.
spaceComplexity: O(h) auxiliary space plus O(b) boundary output space.
